name: claude-skills
description: A marketplace of Claude Code plugins and skills for learning, building, and understanding code.

plugins.name: devflow
plugins.description: Feature work in one flow: requirements in rounds, one design doc carrying every decision, code gated on that doc, UI critiqued before it ships, analytics asked about at the hand-offs.

plugins.name: learning-skills
plugins.description: Skills for learning to code: mentoring a beginner through building their first project, and explaining unfamiliar codebases from zero.

plugins.name: orchestrator
plugins.description: One view over every local Claude Code session: task pools with evidence, child sessions under their parent task, a TUI, and /orch for your phone.

plugins.name: routing
plugins.description: Picks the model and effort for delegated work by task class, enforces it on Agent calls, and logs every choice.

plugins.name: writing-skills
plugins.description: Writing skills: ru-style writes, checks, fixes and scores Russian text — «Пиши, сокращай» (Ильяхов, Сарычева) plus the ru-text rule set.
